📅 2 September 2026 | 🤝 Provisional deal between Parliament & Council confirmed
What's next: The deal is provisional: it still needs a plenary vote in Parliament and formal adoption by the Council. Although confirmation is expected, either institution can still decline.

Summary: This proposal aims to temporarily reduce trade barriers on products from Armenia. The measure would seek to make it easier and cheaper to import Armenian goods into the EU market for a limited period.
